Climate change is the long-term warming of Earth's climate, caused mainly by greenhouse gases from burning fossil fuels, with 2025 about 1.44 °C warmer than pre-industrial times [1].

(Newer figures show that the "about 1.2 °C" in my last answer is out of date; the 2023–2025 average was about 1.48 °C [1].)

sources.title: WMO confirms 2025 was one of warmest years on record
